submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for continuation seams inside an ongoing enumerative or parallel structure (bulleted/numbered/plain lists, table rows and column gaps, repeated code-block lines, runs of parallel items): it fires on the gap whitespace — line breaks, indent runs, inter-column spaces — at second-or-later item boundaries, and on light sentence-initial continuation words (pronouns such as they/them, conjuncts such as yet) that resume discourse after such a structure. It stays near zero on plain-prose paragraph breaks, ordinary single inter-word spaces, and first-item boundaries, and requires on the order of 20–40 preceding tokens of the enumerative structure.
